newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal steady, deposits rise 1/16.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal steady, deposits rise 1/16.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar was steady this week, but riyal interbank deposit rates rose around 1/16 point in quiet year-end trade, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet. Activity focused on short dates," one said.
Spot-next and one-week funds were put at 5-3/8, 1/4 percent.
One-month rates were quoted at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three months at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and one-year were at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent.
The riyal was quoted at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
